answer.justification: The layer-2 spike of 61.9 sits inside the system-prompted range (31.7-64.0), while quantized (0.8-2.8) and fine-tuned (0.7-6.1) are far below it. The layer-wise relative L2 rises to a plateau (0.294 at layer 8, 0.409 at layers 16 and 24, 0.451 at layer 32), matching the system-prompted pattern. Onset layer 9 is close to the 7-8 range. Final cosine 0.877 fits the 0.848-0.900 range, direction consistency 0.534 fits 0.530-0.539, and size ratio 0.975 is just below 1 as expected. Layer 1 (0.153) is slightly above the range, and effective rank 2.94 is slightly high, but neither matches fine-tuned or quantized. The spike value alone rules those out.
